title: UAAP: Rookie Alfanta proving worth to Napa, NU after finally making cut
summary: Macmac Alfanta has continued to prove his worth in UAAP Season 89 after missing out on last year’s squad despite coming in as one of the top players of NU-Nazareth in 2025.
